An adult Chinese man, thirty-four, with rectangular face, strong jaw, short cropped black hair, lean athletic build, stands at her side in a dark tank top and work trousers similarly marked with clay; his right hand is inside the form, fingers spread against the interior wall, while her left hand rests on his wrist guiding his pressure. A thirty-four-year-old adult Chinese man with rectangular face, strong jaw, and short cropped black hair kneels directly before her, his lean athletic build upright on his knees, both hands gripping the weighted silicone form where it hangs from the harness at her pelvis, testing its balance and swing. His face is tilted upward looking at the form's attachment point, his expression concentrated and methodical, while she looks down at the top of his head with a softened gaze, one hand loosely touching her own collarbone. The concrete floor's worn tape marks surround his kneeling position. Shot from a slightly elevated medium distance, the composition centers the hanging form between their bodies; warm light catches the leather and the curve of her hip while his face falls into partial shadow, the dusty shaft of window light creating visible atmosphere between them and the background costume racks.
